_exportButtonLabels: index.tsx:383 — {isDownloading ? 'Exporting…' : isCompleted ? 'Done' : 'Export'}. NOTE the ellipsis is a single U+2026 character, not three dots.

export._observeBusyDelayMs: Delay applied to the REAL export response (res.setDelay) so the transient 'Exporting…' label is observable. Not a stub — the response body and headers are the server's own.

_nonSortableColumnHeader: Every bucket column sets enableSorting:false in index.tsx. Note the EN DASH (–), not a hyphen — the table headers use '0–30 Days' while the Excel export headers use '0-30 Days'.
